title: 第 17 章 这混蛋何时变得这么强了第 18 章上品法器的机缘
slug: 我被师姐凌辱你说我罪恶滔天
lines: 过了许久。
等到夜深之后外门倒是显得格外安静，只有偶尔传来几声虫鸣和巡逻弟子的脚步声。
回到住处的陈默躺在床上没多久就睡着了。
今天在大殿上和陆云陆瑶对峙虽然没有吃什么亏，但也耗费了不少心神。
此刻他睡的倒是沉稳，整个人都处于一种完全放松的状态。
可是到了后半夜的时候陈默迷迷糊糊之间感觉有人在靠近他的房间，脚步很轻明显是刻意压低了声音。
此时陈默想要睁开眼睛但眼皮沉得很，意识还处在半梦半醒之间因此身体也不太听使唤。
门被轻轻推开了发出一声细微的响动，一个黑影闪进了房间然后反手将门关上。
那个女人走到床边并低头看着沉睡中的陈默，她的脸上没有什么表情眼神却格外的冷静。
这时的林凤瑶在心里想着这个陈默的实力提升得太快了，之前还是金丹三层现在恐怕又涨了不少。
白天在大殿上她替陈默说话并不是因为心疼他，而是因为她需要他这个炉鼎。
宗门大典越来越近了她需要更多的真元来提升实力，而陈默就是她最好的选择。
因此林凤瑶弯下腰伸手掀开了被子，然后开始运转双修秘法准备吸取陈默体内的真元。
可就在她俯下身去的瞬间陈默的眼睛突然睁开了，那眼神清醒得很根本不像是刚睡醒的样子。
只见林凤瑶愣了一下还没反应过来是怎么回事，陈默已经一把抓住了她的手腕。
“你……”林凤瑶刚开口就被陈默拉了过去，整个人失去平衡倒在了床上。
而陈默也立刻翻身将林凤瑶压在身下。
眼神里带着几分冷意。
“师姐这么晚来找师弟，不知道有什么事。”陈默淡淡道。
只见林凤瑶挣扎了一下想要挣脱却发现陈默的力量大得惊人，她在心里想着这个家伙的实力怎么又变强了？
“陈默你放开我。”林凤瑶冷声道。
“放开你然后让你继续把我当炉鼎吸取我的真元吗？”陈默说道。
此时林凤瑶的脸色变了一下，她没想到陈默会这么直接的说出来。
“你在说什么我听不懂。”林凤瑶说道。
“听不懂没关系，师姐既然这么喜欢双修那今晚就让师弟来教教你什么叫真正的双修吧。”
听到这话后林凤瑶的脸色彻底变了。
可她想反抗已经来不及了，陈默的实力比她想象的要强得多而且那股力量还在不断的增长。
一夜的疯狂持续到了天亮，房间里还不时传出各种声响。
第二天早上陈默还躺在床上整个人都显得很放松，不过林凤瑶从床上爬起来的动作倒是显得有几分艰难，她的腿在发软腰也酸得不行，甚至走路的时候都需要扶着墙。
转过头看了一眼还在休息的陈默她心中涌起一股说不出的滋味。
这个家伙的实力越来越强了之前不是才金丹三层吗，怎么这么快又提升了……
过了一会儿林凤瑶扶着墙一步一步的走出了房间。
走在回去的路上她脑中一直在想着这件事，陈默的实力提升得太快了而且快得有些不正常，这才过去多久他就从练气期一路突破到了金丹期而且还在不断往上涨。
按照这个速度下去，过不了多久他的修为就要超过自己了。
此时林凤瑶咬了咬牙，看来必须想个办法不能让他这么提升下去不然到时候谁把谁当炉鼎还不一定呢。
回到自己的修炼地之后林凤瑶坐下来调息了一下，她的身体还是有些酸软但比刚才好多了。
正在这时她听到外面传来一阵声音，推开窗户一看就看到陆瑶正在院子里扫地。
只见陆瑶的脸上还带着不甘的表情，她拿着扫帚一边扫地一边嘴里还在嘀咕着什么。
本来林凤瑶不想理她，可陆瑶抬头看到窗户后面的林凤瑶却立刻就走了过来。
“林凤瑶你为什么要护着那个陈默。”陆瑶质问道。
“你是我师姐你不帮我就算了，居然还帮着他说话你到底是什么意思。”
可是林凤瑶看着她脸上的表情没有什么变化，她心想这个陆瑶真是被惯坏了。
“我没有什么意思。”林凤瑶说道。
“没有什么意思，你在大殿上替他说话还说没有什么意思。”
content_en:
After a long time.
As the night progressed, the outer door seemed particularly quiet, with only the occasional chirping of insects and the footsteps of patrolling disciples.
After returning to his residence, Chen Mo lay on the bed and fell asleep soon after.
Although I did not suffer any loss from the confrontation with Lu Yun and Lu Yao in the main hall today, it also consumed a lot of energy.
He was sleeping peacefully at the moment, and his whole body was in a state of complete relaxation.
But in the second half of the night, Chen Mo felt someone approaching his room in a daze. His footsteps were light and his voice was obviously deliberately lowered.
At this time, Chen Mo wanted to open his eyes, but his eyelids were very heavy. His consciousness was still in a state of half-dream and half-awake, so his body was not very responsive.
The door was pushed open slightly and there was a slight noise. A black figure flashed into the room and closed the door behind his back.
The woman walked to the bed and looked down at the sleeping Chen Mo. Her face had no expression but her eyes were extremely calm.
At this time, Lin Fengyao was thinking in her mind that Chen Mo's strength had improved too quickly. He was still at the third level of Jin Dan before and now it has probably increased a lot.
She spoke for Chen Mo in the main hall during the day not because she felt sorry for him, but because she needed him as a furnace.
The sect ceremony is getting closer and closer. She needs more true energy to improve her strength, and Chen Mo is her best choice.
Therefore, Lin Fengyao bent down and reached out to lift the quilt, and then began to use the secret method of dual cultivation to absorb the true energy from Chen Mo's body.
But the moment she leaned down, Chen Mo's eyes suddenly opened. His eyes were so awake that it didn't look like he had just woken up.
Lin Fengyao was stunned for a moment and before she could realize what was going on, Chen Mo had already grabbed her wrist.
"You..." As soon as Lin Fengyao opened her mouth, she was pulled over by Chen Mo. She lost her balance and fell on the bed.
Chen Mo also immediately turned over and pressed Lin Fengyao under him.
There was a bit of coldness in his eyes.
"Senior Sister came to see Junior Brother so late. I wonder what's going on." Chen Mo said calmly.
Lin Fengyao struggled for a moment to break away, but found that Chen Mo's strength was amazing. She thought to herself: Why has this guy become stronger again?
"Chen Mo, let me go." Lin Fengyao said coldly.
"Let you go and let you continue to use me as a cauldron to absorb my true energy?" Chen Mo said.
At this time, Lin Fengyao's expression changed. She didn't expect Chen Mo to say it so directly.
"I don't understand what you are saying." Lin Fengyao said.
"It doesn't matter if you don't understand. Since senior sister likes dual cultivation so much, let me let junior brother teach you what real dual cultivation is tonight."
Lin Fengyao's expression changed completely after hearing this.
But it was too late for her to resist. Chen Mo was much stronger than she imagined and that power was still growing.
The crazy night lasted until dawn, and various noises were heard in the room from time to time.
…
The next morning, Chen Mo was still lying on the bed and seemed very relaxed. However, it was a bit difficult for Lin Fengyao to get up from the bed. Her legs were weak and her waist was so sore that she even had to hold on to the wall when walking.
Turning her head and taking a look at Chen Mo, who was still resting, she felt an indescribable feeling in her heart.
This guy's strength is getting stronger and stronger. Wasn't he only at the third level of Jindan before? How come he has improved so quickly...
After a while, Lin Fengyao walked out of the room step by step, holding on to the wall.
She kept thinking about this on the way back. Chen Mo's strength had improved too fast and was abnormally fast. In just a short time, he had broken through from the qi training stage to the golden elixir stage, and it was still rising.
If he continues at this rate, it won't be long before his cultivation level surpasses his own.
At this time, Lin Fengyao gritted her teeth. It seemed that she had to find a way to prevent him from being promoted like this, otherwise it would not be certain who would be the leader.
After returning to her training ground, Lin Fengyao sat down and adjusted her breathing. Her body was still a little sore but much better than before.
At this moment, she heard a sound coming from outside. When she opened the window, she saw Lu Yao sweeping the floor in the yard.
Lu Yao still had an unwilling expression on her face. She was sweeping the floor with a broom and mumbling something.
Originally Lin Fengyao didn't want to pay attention to her, but when Lu Yao looked up and saw Lin Fengyao behind the window, she immediately came over.
"Lin Fengyao, why are you protecting that Chen Mo?" Lu Yao asked.
"You are my senior sister. It's okay if you don't help me, but you still help him. What do you mean?"
But Lin Fengyao saw that the expression on her face had not changed much, and she thought to herself that this Lu Yao was really spoiled.
"I don't mean anything." Lin Fengyao said.
"It doesn't mean anything. You speak for him in the main hall and you say it doesn't mean anything."
title_en: Chapter 17: When did this bastard become so strong? Chapter 18: The opportunity of high-grade magic weapon
